design_rule: Use the market lens to explain expected future cash-flow capitalization, then place the Korea–Italy comparison and OECD context in small deterministic source cards. The visual story never treats listed-market value as a judgment on national worth.

clusters.purpose: Show the limited listed-market comparison as a way of asking what public markets price, then correct the reductive Italy joke with its advanced industrial reality.
must_not_imply: that the market is always right

clusters.purpose: Move from the comparison to the cautious macro case: technology intensity and semiconductor exports are part of a larger repricing of strategic production capacity.
clusters.asset_strategy: reframe from the neutral market lens to the strategic-chokepoint network, then reveal the dated OECD context card.
